name: ditto-flutter
description: Ditto Flutter/Dart SDK (ditto_live) assistance — iOS, Android, macOS, Windows, Linux and Flutter Web apps: pubspec and platform setup, connecting, authentication, transports, subscriptions, DQL execution, observers in a widget tree, attachments, presence, web differences, testing and v4 to v5 migration. Covers Ditto SDK 4.14.x (LTS), 5.0.x, 5.1.x and 5.2.0
